title: retry-storm
blurb: A webhook client retries every failure immediately, multiplying a partner outage and ignoring server backpressure.
brief:
A partner degradation became a retry storm: request volume tripled within milliseconds, permanent 400 responses were retried, and `Retry-After` was ignored. The transport is synchronous and dependency-free.

Start with `logs/incident.log` and `runbook.md`. Tests provide a fake sleeper, so no real waiting is necessary. Preserve the public return value and expose permanent rejection distinctly from exhausted transient retries.

**Your job:** classify retryable responses, honor server backpressure, and apply bounded exponential backoff without an off-by-one attempt.

javascript.brief:
A partner degradation became a retry storm in this Node.js delivery client: request volume tripled, permanent failures were retried, and `Retry-After` was ignored.

Start with `logs/incident.log` and `runbook.md`. Tests inject a fake sleeper, so do not add real waits or randomness. Preserve the response contract and distinguish permanent rejection from exhausted transient retries.

**Your job:** repair `src/delivery.js` with bounded, classified retries.
